verifiedProperties: Company common guard checks current server-loaded req.org.verification_status, not stale client session metadata, after authenticated current company membership/context checks. Pending/unverified/rejected operational paths deny, onboarding allowlist remains owner/organization scoped.
Auth signup persists company pending/canceled metadata and zero wallet without any trial/subscription INSERT; session payload carries organizationVerificationStatus from current organization.

Company shell remount uses stable organization ID. Missing selected company context renders explicit chooser; pending operational children are suppressed and Support/settings/notifications remain usable.

Direct company allocation checks company type/current verified status and active actor/member permissions with shared row locks inside the balance/idempotency transaction. Replays cannot bypass a revoked company approval.

Wallet fuel sale locks the card and current company organization; prior-issued company codes cannot spend while company approval is pending. Verified fixtures retain expected lawful transaction sequencing.
PIN setup/change checks actual current locked hash/ownership, stores no plaintext PIN metadata, exposes only pinSet, and invalidates active wallet fuel code atomically with the new hash.

CardPage terminal cancelled/withdrawn/refunded/payment-refunded/issuance-refund-pending branches cannot resume payment or collect identity; withdrawal outcome survives subsequent read error; only full-kind succeeded refund or explicit refunded request state confirms full refund.

Shared dialog hook intentionally captures the open dialog in its effect keyed by ref/open. Closing on organization key change releases the old listener/scroll-lock capture; reopening captures the current connected container. The new topbar ref provides a visible focus recovery target for an open mobile drawer.
